text:
I can't give a verified current figure. My latest firm knowledge is the target range of 3.50%-3.75%, set at the December 2025 FOMC meeting. I'm not certain what happened at the 2026 meetings after that, and the FOMC has met several times since my cutoff, including likely in July and September 2026, so the range may have changed.

For the current value, check the Fed's FOMC page (federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy) or the New York Fed's effective federal funds rate (EFFR), which is the actual market rate and sits inside the target range.
